def VTask.strongDownwardInduction : {α : Type u_1} -> {p : Finset α → Sort u_4} -> {n : ℕ} -> (H : (t₁ : Finset α) → ({t₂ : Finset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ ⊂ t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁) -> (s : Finset α) -> s.card ≤ n → p s := by
  intro α p n H s hs
  have h₁ : ∀ (s : Finset α), s.card ≤ n → p s := by
    intro s
    induction' s using Finset.induction_on with a s has ih
    -- Base case: the empty set
    · intro h
      have h₂ := H ∅ (fun t₂ ht₂ hsub => by
        have h₃ : (∅ : Finset α) ⊂ t₂ := hsub
        have h₄ : t₂.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_of_ne_empty (by intro h₅; simp_all [Finset.subset_iff])
        simp_all [Finset.subset_iff]
        <;> aesop
      ) (by simp_all)
      exact h₂
    -- Inductive step: add an element `a` to the set `s`
    · intro h
      have h₂ := H (insert a s) (fun t₂ ht₂ hsub =>
        -- For any strict superset `t₂` of `insert a s`, we need to show that `t₂.card ≤ n`
        have h₃ : (insert a s : Finset α) ⊂ t₂ := hsub
        have h₄ : t₂.card ≤ n := ht₂
        -- Use the inductive hypothesis to get `p t₂`
        by_cases h₅ : a ∈ t₂
        · -- Case: `a ∈ t₂`
          have h₆ : s ⊆ t₂ := by
            have h₇ : insert a s ⊂ t₂ := hsub
            have h₈ : insert a s ⊆ t₂ := Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp h₇ |>.1
            have h₉ : s ⊆ insert a s := Finset.subset_insert a s
            exact Finset.Subset.trans h₉ h₈
          have h₇ : s.card ≤ t₂.card := Finset.card_le_of_subset h₆
          have h₈ : s.card ≤ n := by
            have h₉ : (insert a s).card ≤ n := by
              have h₁₀ : (insert a s).card ≤ n := by
                have h₁₁ : (insert a s).card = s.card + 1 := by
                  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem]
                  <;> aesop
                have h₁₂ : s.card + 1 ≤ n := by
                  have h₁₃ : (insert a s).card ≤ n := by
                    have h₁₄ : (insert a s).card ≤ n := by
                      simp_all [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem]
                      <;> omega
                    exact h₁₄
                  simp_all [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem]
                  <;> omega
                omega
              exact h₁₀
            have h₁₀ : s.card < (insert a s).card := by
              have h₁₁ : s.card < (insert a s).card := by
                have h₁₂ : a ∉ s := by aesop
                have h₁₃ : (insert a s).card = s.card + 1 := by
                  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem]
                  <;> aesop
                omega
              exact h₁₁
            omega
          have h₉ : p t₂ := ih t₂ ht₂ (by
            have h₁₀ : s ⊆ t₂ := h₆
            have h₁₁ : s.card ≤ t₂.card := Finset.card_le_of_subset h₁₀
            have h₁₂ : s.card ≤ n := h₈
            have h₁₃ : t₂.card ≤ n := ht₂
            have h₁₄ : s ⊂ t₂ := by
              have h₁₅ : s ⊆ t₂ := h₆
              have h₁₆ : s ≠ t₂ := by
                intro h₁₇
                have h₁₈ : insert a s ⊂ t₂ := hsub
                have h₁₉ : insert a s ⊆ t₂ := Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp h₁₈ |>.1
                have h₂₀ : t₂ ⊆ insert a s := by
                  rw [h₁₇] at *
                  <;> simp_all [Finset.subset_iff]
                  <;> aesop
                have h₂₁ : insert a s = t₂ := Finset.Subset.antisymm h₁₉ h₂₀
                simp_all [Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne]
                <;> aesop
              exact Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨h₁₅, h₁₆⟩
            simp_all [Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne]
            <;> aesop
          )
          exact h₉
        · -- Case: `a ∉ t₂`
          exfalso
          have h₆ : (insert a s : Finset α) ⊂ t₂ := hsub
          have h₇ : a ∈ insert a s := by simp
          have h₈ : a ∈ t₂ := by
            have h₉ : insert a s ⊆ t₂ := Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp h₆ |>.1
            exact h₉ h₇
          contradiction
      ) (by
        -- Prove that `(insert a s).card ≤ n`
        have h₃ : (insert a s).card ≤ n := by
          have h₄ : s.card ≤ n := by
            have h₅ : s.card < (insert a s).card := by
              have h₆ : a ∉ s := by aesop
              have h₇ : (insert a s).card = s.card + 1 := by
                rw [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem]
                <;> aesop
              omega
            have h₈ : (insert a s).card ≤ n := by
              simp_all [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem]
              <;> omega
            omega
          have h₅ : (insert a s).card = s.card + 1 := by
            rw [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem]
            <;> aesop
          have h₆ : s.card + 1 ≤ n := by
            have h₇ : (insert a s).card ≤ n := by
              simp_all [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem]
              <;> omega
            simp_all [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem]
            <;> omega
          omega
        exact h₃
